bands.tip: Do Waterfall Quest at level 1 (no reqs) to jump straight to 30 Attack/Strength; other melee quests push it further.
Kill crabs - Sand Crabs (Hosidius/Crabclaw), Ammonite Crabs (Fossil Island) or the Gemstone Crab in Varlamore; AFK, little food.
Nightmare Zone Normal Rumble north of Yanille - very AFK with absorption + overload potions (needs ~5 quests).
Nightmare Zone for fastest solo Attack XP; Dharok's set becomes optimal at 92+ Hitpoints, else Blood Moon / Obsidian.
Waterfall Quest at level 1 jumps you to 30 Strength/Attack; afterwards train on the Aggressive attack style for Strength.
Kill crabs on Aggressive - Sand/Ammonite Crabs or the Gemstone Crab in Varlamore; AFK with super strength potions for more XP.
Nightmare Zone Normal Rumble north of Yanille - very AFK with absorption + overload potions (needs ~5 quests).
Nightmare Zone for fastest solo Strength XP; Dharok's set becomes optimal at 92+ Hitpoints, else Blood Moon / Obsidian.
Train on the Defensive attack style (or Controlled to spread all three melee stats); Waterfall/melee quests give some Defence.
Kill crabs on Defensive - Sand/Ammonite Crabs or the Gemstone Crab in Varlamore; AFK with little food needed.
Nightmare Zone north of Yanille; Venator bow on Long-range earns Defence, or absorption Rumble for AFK.
Nightmare Zone; note Ancient Magicks on Defensive or chinning maniacal monkeys on Long-range give more Defence XP/hr than melee.
Cannon monsters with a dwarf multicannon (needs Dwarf Cannon), e.g. ogres east of Castle Wars; or AFK crabs with the best darts.
Chin (throw chinchompas at) maniacal monkeys in Kruk's Dungeon, Ape Atoll (needs Monkey Madness II ch.II) - fastest Ranged XP.
Skip early levels with Prayer quests (The Restless Ghost, Priest in Peril, Recruitment Drive, Holy Grail -> ~30).
Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.
Fastest: enchant gem-tipped bolts (expensive). Cheaper passive: cast Low Level Alchemy from 21 while doing other things.
Cast High Level Alchemy (alching) while doing other activities - the best passive Magic XP and profits per cast.
Burst/barrage monsters on Ancient Magicks (needs Desert Treasure I) in multi-combat, ideally on Slayer tasks (dust devils, nechryael).
Skip early levels with quests (Client of Kourend etc.); the Guardians of the Rift minigame opens at 27.
Craft lava runes at the Fire Altar (essence + earth runes, wear a binding necklace) - fastest solo; or play Guardians of the Rift.
Craft blood/soul runes at the Arceuus altars for XP + profit; lava runes with essence runners stay fastest overall.
Build crude chairs -> bookcases -> oak larders in your POH (bring saw, hammer, steel nails); Mahogany Homes is a cheaper alternative.
Build oak larders in the POH Kitchen (8 oak planks each) - cheap and fast; switch to oak dungeon doors at 74 to stay cheap.
Build mahogany tables then gnome benches in the Dining room with a demon butler - fastest XP but expensive (teak/oak to save gp).
HP trains passively from combat (1 damage = 1.33 HP XP) - any fast melee/ranged/magic method (crabs, NMZ, Slayer) levels it.
For dedicated HP XP, Ice Burst/Barrage skeletal or maniacal monkeys at Ape Atoll (70 Magic + quests), or chin maniacal monkeys.
Skip early levels with quests (The Tourist Trap -> 26), or start a rooftop course for marks of grace / the graceful outfit.
Brimhaven Agility Arena for fastest XP (floor-spike trap from 20, tag the pillars); rooftop courses if you want graceful.
Wilderness Agility Course - fastest here (deep Wilderness, keep risk low and watch for PKers).
Hallowed Sepulchre (needs Sins of the Father) for fastest XP + profit; rooftop courses if you still need graceful.
Make the highest potion you can as you level: Attack (3) -> Strength (12) -> Energy (26) -> Prayer (38). Quests skip the early grind.
Make Super attack (45) -> Super energy (52) -> Super strength (55) -> Super restore (63); always the highest-XP potion you can afford.
Make Super restore (63) -> Ranging (72) -> Saradomin brew (81) -> Super combat (90); amulet of chemistry / goggles cut the cost.
Pickpocket the Chambers of Xeric thieving room (bring a lockpick), or steal Aldarin Villas chests (36-45); quests skip to 42.
Blackjack bandits in Pollnivneach (needs partial The Feud) with rogue equipment + Saradomin brews.
Steal artefacts in Port Piscarilius for the fastest XP from 49 to 65.
Blackjack Menaphite Thugs in Pollnivneach (fastest to 84); Pyramid Plunder becomes fastest past 91.
Craft the highest leather item you can (gloves -> body -> chaps) with a needle and thread.
Cut gems for fastest XP: sapphire -> emerald -> ruby -> diamond; keep cutting diamonds to 62.
Craft battlestaves (fire/earth, cheaper) or keep cutting gems - both good up to 77.
Craft d'hide bodies (green -> blue -> red -> black dragonhide) near a bank - fastest to 99.
Skip low levels with quests; fletch arrow shafts (1-5) then start cutting & stringing bows. Darts are the fastest passive option.
Cut & string the best bows you can (oak->willow->maple->yew->magic), or fletch darts in 'zero time' while questing/Slayer/Agility.
Get tasks from Turael/Spria (Burthorpe/Draynor, any level); block or skip disliked tasks. Slayer XP tracks combat, so train combat too.
Take tasks from Mazchna in Canifis (20 combat) - use the highest master your combat level allows.
Use Vannaka (Edgeville Dungeon, 40 cb), then Chaeldar in Zanaris (70 cb, needs Lost City).
Use the highest master you can: Konar (75 cb), Nieve/Steve (85 cb), then Duradel (100 cb+50 Slay); switch two masters for milestone points.
Do the Natural History Quiz in Varrock Museum (1,000 XP, straight to level 9).
Bird house trapping on Fossil Island (needs Bone Voyage) - passive runs every 50 min, fastest XP to ~80; drift net at 44 if training Fishing.
Keep bird house runs (viable to 99), or for fastest active XP hunt black chinchompas (73+) / do Hunters' Rumours; Herbiboar is AFK.
Powermine (drop) copper/tin ore anywhere; the Lumbridge Swamp mine is quiet and has both.
Powermine iron at a 3-rock triangle spot (Al Kharid etc.); Varrock armour gives 10% double ore; Mining Guild best from 60+.
3-tick mine granite (3t4g) at Bandit Camp Quarry / Cape Conch for fastest XP; no-tick: iron to 70 then Volcanic Mine. AFK: Motherlode Mine.
Skip early levels with quests (The Knight's Sword etc.); else smith the highest item you can at the Varrock west-bank anvil.
Smelt gold bars at the Blast Furnace with goldsmith gauntlets (fastest viable); Giants' Foundry is a good XP + profit alternative.
Skip early levels with quests - Sea Slug alone reaches 24, faster than catching low-level fish.
3-tick fly fish trout/salmon at a static spot (e.g. SE of Prifddinas) for fastest XP; Tempoross is a good no-tick option from 35.
3-tick Barbarian Fishing (also gives Agility/Strength); drift net fishing on Fossil Island if training Hunter too.
1-tick cook raw karambwan into poison karambwan (fastest, no reqs); or cook fish sardine->salmon on a range for a cheaper option.
1-tick cook karambwan (needs Tai Bwo Wannai Trio) at a bankside fire - Rogues' Den, Myths' Guild or Mor Ul Rek; AFK: Hosidius kitchen.
1-tick make redwood/rosewood pyre logs (needs Shades of Mort'ton) for fastest XP; else burn coloured/firelighter logs.
Burn the best logs you can (willow->teak->maple->yew->magic->redwood) at east Grand Exchange; Wintertodt at 50+ is a good XP+loot option.
Chop regular trees and drop the logs; Woodcutting quests can skip you to 26.
Chop oak trees (slightly faster than willows here); keep dropping the logs.
Chop teak trees - 1.5-tick teaks on Fossil Island is the fastest in game. AFK/no-tick: teaks to 65 then sulliuscep mushrooms.
Skip early levels with quests (up to ~38). Fast active start: plant bagged plants in your POH (expensive).
Do tree runs 1-2x/day: plant the best tree/fruit-tree/hardwood saplings you can, check for XP, replant - by far the fastest effective XP.
